query:
INSERT INTO external_credit_targets (
    id,
    moocfi_course_id,
    moocfi_course_slug,
    name,
    language_code,
    tiers,
    uh_course_code,
    ects_credits,
    grading,
    enrolment_link,
    delegated_at,
    enabled_at
  )
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    CASE
      WHEN $6 THEN int4range($7::int, $8::int, '[]')
    END,
    $9,
    $10,
    $11,
    $12,
    $13,
    $14
  )
RETURNING id
